hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
Careful examination (**hh:hwdial:Gates:Jiarong**) of Jiarong speech varieties filed under Jiarong [jya] in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 necessitate the recognition of separate languages divisible as Situ
(**hh:s:Nagano:Cogtse**), Zbu (**hh:s:Sun:Caodeng**), Tshobdun (**hh:hwdial:Gates:Jiarong**) and Japhug (**hh:g:Jacques:Jiarongyu**). Thus, E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has three entries too few. See also: Jiarong [jya].
